title: SMBus 3.x target with the PMBus 1.3 command layer: PEC, clock stretching, STATUS_CML fault reporting, WRITE_PROTECT, SMBALERT# with the Alert Response Address, spike filter, SDA hold time, bus timeout

regs.name: VOUT
regs.desc: Output-voltage set point commanded over PMBus

fields.desc: VOUT_COMMAND (21h), linear 16-bit mantissa, exponent from VOUT_MODE (-9)

regs.name: CTRL
regs.desc: On / off control commanded over PMBus

regs.name: TELEMETRY
regs.desc: Measured output voltage, returned by READ_VOUT (8Bh)

fields.desc: write 1: a VOUT overvoltage fault; latched into STATUS_BYTE / STATUS_WORD and SMBALERT# until CLEAR_FAULTS

irqs.name: CML
irqs.desc: a STATUS_CML bit was set (unsupported command, invalid data, PEC failure, bus timeout)

irqs.name: UPD
irqs.desc: the host wrote OPERATION, ON_OFF_CONFIG or VOUT_COMMAND

irqs.name: TO
irqs.desc: SCL was held low for TIMEOUT clocks in a transfer; the target released the bus

features: SMBus 3.x target at address ADDR (default 0x5A): Send Byte, Write Byte / Word, Read Byte / Word and Block Read, each with an optional PEC byte (CRC-8).
PMBus 1.3 commands OPERATION, ON_OFF_CONFIG, CLEAR_FAULTS, WRITE_PROTECT, CAPABILITY, VOUT_MODE, VOUT_COMMAND, STATUS_BYTE, STATUS_WORD, STATUS_CML, READ_VOUT, PMBUS_REVISION and MFR_ID.

Fault reporting in STATUS_CML (unsupported command, invalid data, PEC failed, other communication fault) with the matching byte NACKed; a write only takes effect at STOP when it was complete and error-free.
SMBALERT# with the Alert Response Address (0x0C): the target returns its address, releases SMBALERT# when it wins the arbitration, and pulls it again on a new fault.
Bus timing: SCL / SDA spike filter of FILT clocks, SDA changed HOLD clocks after SCL falls, SCL stretched for STRETCH clocks after each address ACK, tTIMEOUT after TIMEOUT clocks of SCL low.
notes: scl and sda are the bus inputs; scl_o, sda_o and smbalert_n are open-drain outputs (0 pulls the line low). They pass through unchanged.
Not implemented: the SMBus Address Resolution Protocol (fixed address), Host Notify, Quick Command, Block Write and the PMBus fault-response, limit and telemetry commands beyond READ_VOUT.
